malaysian.diploma_pathway: Diploma in relevant field with CGPA 2.0

requirements.general_text: STPM Pass STPM with at least Grade C (CGPA 2.00) in any 2 subjects Additional Requirements: Mathematics (SPM): Pass (E) English (SPM): Pass (E) Candidates without Mathematics & English at SPM level must take equivalent courses during their studies. Matriculation Pass Matriculation with at least CGPA 2.00 Additional Requirements: Mathematics (SPM): Pass (E) English (SPM): Pass (E) Foundation Pass Foundation with at least CGPA 2.00 Additional Requirements: Mathematics (SPM): Pass (E) English (SPM): Pass (E) A-Level Pass A-Level with at least Grade C (CGPA 2.00) in any 2 subjects Additional Requirements: Mathematics (SPM): Pass (E) English (SPM): Pass (E) Diploma Pass Diploma (Level 4, MQF) or Advanced Diploma (Level 5, MQF) with at least CGPA 2.00 Additional Requirements: Mathematics (SPM): Pass (E) English (SPM): Pass (E) STAM Pass STAM with at least Grade JAYYID Additional Requirements: Mathematics (SPM): Pass (E) English (SPM): Pass (E) Note: Candidates without a credit in Mathematics and English at SPM level must take equivalent subjects during their studies.     ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS For Malaysian Students: Students have taken MUET before enrol. However, students are required to complete MUET during the duration of the study (before graduation). IELTS (5.0 and above) or TOEFL (500 and above) or TOEFL Internet-Based Test (42 and above) is also accepted. MUET – Malaysia University English Test Achieve Band 1 and above For International Students: International students are required to have one of the English proficiency scores stated below to enrol in UNITEN. Bachelor students who do not fulfil this English requirement are required to sit for the Intensive English Programme (IEP) and pass the requirement below before starting their Bachelor programme. MUET – Malaysia University English Test Achieve Band 3.5 and above   IELTS – International English Language Testing System Achieve 5.5 and above   TOEFL - Test of English as a Foreign Language Achieve 500 (TOEFL) or 46 (TOEFL Internet Based Test) and above
